Yes — filtering by tag matches what I wanted: a bookmark can hold more than one tag, the sidebar makes picking one easy, one click narrows the library, and a tag choice stacks with what I type in search. All good.

The one part of tags we haven't actually touched is the other side of it — how tags get *onto* a bookmark in the first place. When I'm saving or editing, I'd want to put one or more tags on it myself, and as I type a tag I'd love it to suggest ones I've already used so I don't end up with "recipe" and "recipes" as two separate things by accident. That matters to me because messy, near-duplicate tags are exactly what would make the filtering we just built less useful. Can we look at adding and suggesting tags on a bookmark next?
